srs.title: SRS Overview
srs.summary: The system is a payment platform tailored for small businesses in India, designed to handle payment links, transaction reconciliation, refunds, and reporting. It will integrate with a third-party payment gateway and enforce strict role-based access (Admin, Merchant) along with a comprehensive audit.
assumptions: The business operates within the regulatory framework of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), specifically under the 'Digital Payment Security Controls Directions 2020' (E3), governing regulated entities.
The platform is subject to risk assessments prior to launch and on a regular basis, covering technology stacks, vulnerabilities, and third-party dependencies (E4).
The 'in-house risk & compliance team' (User Answer Q1) is authorized and capable of performing onboarding and final approval for merchants, ensuring adherence to governance policies.
The system must enforce security controls such as blocking access after a specific number of failed login attempts and providing secure re-activation procedures (E2).
stakeholders: Internal Stakeholders: In-house Risk & Compliance Team (responsible for merchant onboarding/approval per User Answer Q1), Internal Admins, Merchants.
External Stakeholders: Payment Gateway Provider, Payment Customers (small businesses using the platform).
Regulatory Bodies: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and its departments (DPSS, DoR, DoS) as per E3/E5.
Third-party Personnel: Staff of the integrated payment gateway (subject to oversight per E4).
